review_requirements: During construction, account for each native face exactly once, retain its UV/PBR association, and confirm nonempty visible selections for all eight bodies. Cover tabs follow their covers; orange compartment floors remain on main_lid; the handle opening remains clear. Record connector additions against the two approved repair budgets.

Using direct joint transforms only, inspect each of the seven controls at 0, pi/4 and pi/2 for visible surface movement and attachment continuity. Check the main rear support, both handle seats, clasp upper attachments and cover hinge edges. Inspect handle and covers separately with the main lid closed; then inspect lid opening with clasps released and covers closed. These are construction pose inspections, not simulated endpoint, contact or load tests.

Confirm the browser applies supported visual-to-body offsets: opening main_lid carries handle, both clasps and all three covers, while each child control moves its own visible assembly. Save GLB, editable Blender source and interactive metadata with all seven controls and stated limitations; publish after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Do not run simulation, physical tests or a physical acceptance loop.
